about.text: A grana-style cheese from the Province of Trento, a recognised sub-denomination within DOP Grana Padano, with its own mark on the rind. Its specification allows only milk, salt and rennet; the milk is evening milk with its skimmed cream plus morning milk. Some sources treat it as a separate DOP.

sources.text: Milk, the rennet-only specification, origin and sub-denomination status.
